explanation.en: Two nouns chained: the first (mudaf) never takes الـ or tanwin; the second (mudaf ilayh) is always majrur and supplies the definiteness. مُعَلِّمِهِ = مُعَلِّم + ه: "his teacher" — definite because of the pronoun, though مُعَلِّم itself carries no الـ. An attached pronoun (ـه، ـي…) counts as a mudaf ilayh in the position of jarr.
explanation.tr: İki isim tamlaması: birincisi (muzaf) asla الـ ve tenvin almaz; ikincisi (muzafun ileyh) daima mecrurdur ve belirliliği sağlar. مُعَلِّمِهِ = مُعَلِّم + ه: 'onun hocası'. Bitişik zamir, cer mahallinde muzafun ileyhtir.

why.en: The mudaf never takes الـ — definiteness flows up from the mudaf ilayh.
why.tr: Muzaf asla الـ almaz — belirlilik muzafun ileyhten gelir.

why.en: The mudaf also never takes tanwin — tanwin and idafa exclude each other.
why.tr: Muzaf tenvin de almaz — tenvin ile izafet bir arada bulunmaz.
